title: Dimension World Spawn
description: Extends /setworldspawn so you can choose a dimension and coordinates.
body:
Are you tired of going in Nether after you've been killed? Or you don't have respawn anchor in the end? Or you're going to make a spawn in other dimension on your server? 
This mod extends /setworldspawn so you can choose a dimension and coordinates.

![After choosing the dimension you can choose coordinates.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7765fa5ab21925d9a9d4b6ed027c77c838528e1e.gif)
